info.title: EZTVSwap
info.author: Ignachob
info.description: Swap HDMI/Analog output with a combo
info.details:
A Wii U Aroma plugin that swaps the TV video output between HDMI and an analog connection (Component, Composite or SCART) using a button combo.

Perfect for quickly switching to a CRT TV (e.g. 480i over Component) and back, without digging into the system settings. The change is temporary — after a reboot the console returns to its normal system video mode.

Default combo: D-Pad Left + TV (on the GamePad), while in the Wii U Menu.
1st press -> switches to the analog mode (Component 480i @ 4:3 by default).
2nd press -> restores the original HDMI mode.
Open the plugin config menu with L + D-Pad Down + Minus (GamePad / Pro Controller / Classic Controller).
